reviews.review: A ton of fun and replay ability.
The best 2d roguelike made into 3d. Its all that you expect and more.

Release 1.0 Review: Before, i guess i only played the game with friends sometimes because it was a nice way to pass the time. There is so much replay value that comes out of how the game chooses what enemies to spawn and the random spawning of items from chests. Artifacts STILL give way more replay value than i ever could have given them credit for. I love combining the artifacts of Command, Sacrifice, and Swarms. The characters' different play styles can appeal to almost everyone because you have characters like Commando and Huntress who are ranged single target damage characters, and then you have characters like Mercenary and Loader who are In-Your-Face melee characters, and characters like Artificer and Acrid who excel at clearing groups of enemies with their area of effect and damage over time skills respectively. other characters like Captain and Engineer can be played as support characters who heal allies or provide safe spaces for allies. The game is absolutely amazing. Every aspect of it. The art style, the mechanics, the items, the enemies, the characters, and ESPECIALLY the soundtrack. I fully believe Risk of Rain 2 has the BEST soundtrack i have EVER heard in any game. Chris Christodoulou has previously worked on some of the best soundtracks out there in video games such as Deadbolt and Risk of Rain 1. The soundtrack to this game literally makes me transcend to a higher plane of existence. PLEASE listen to the soundtrack even if you're not going to buy the game. It's on spotify.


Early Access Review: So, basically, this game is STILL in Early Access and it ALREADY ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ rocks. The new Artifacts update definitely gives absolute replay value because one artifact lets you just CHOOSE what items you want from a chest and that alone has replay value because you can build anything you want. Now take into account that there are 16 total artifacts that each add their own twist to the game. This game is awesome. Buy it. Even if it's not on sale, I guarantee that it's worth it.
I'm not normally a fan of roguelikes, but this is good stuff.
